technical-data.invention-title: COMPOSITIONS COSMETIQUES CONTENANT DE LA VITAMINE B3

abstract.p: Disclosed are cosmetic compositions, including lipsticks, comprising from 0.01 % to about 50 %, by weight, of cylindrical crystalline vitamin B3 particles having a particle size distribution such that at least about 70 % of the crystalline particles have a height to width ratio greater than 1; from about 1 % to about 90 %, by weight, of an emollient component; from about 1 % to about 90 %, by weight, of a solidifying agent; and from about 1 % to about 90 %, on an anhydrous basis, of a color. The compositions provide improved skin feel of crystalline vitamin B3 compounds when applied to skin.

L'invention concerne des compositions cosmétiques, notamment des bâtons de rouge à lèvres, qui renferment: environ entre 0,01 % et 50 % en poids de particules de vitamine B3 cylindriques cristallines avec une distribution granulométrique de sorte qu'au moins 70 % environ de ces particules cristallines présentent un rapport hauteur à largeur supérieur à 1; environ entre 1 % et 90 % en poids d'un constituant émollient; environ entre 1 % et 90 % en poids d'un agent solidifiant; et environ entre 1 % et 90 % d'une couleur, sur une base anhydre. Les composés de vitamine B3 cristallins de ces compositions offrent une sensation améliorée une fois ces dernières appliquées sur la peau.

description.p: The present invention relates to topical cosmetic compositions containing cylindrical crystalline vitamin B3 compounds.

Niacm, also known as vitamm B3, is the common name for mcotinic acid. The physiologically active form of niacin is niacinamide, also a member of the vitamm B3 family of compounds. Niacm and niacinamide (nicotinic acid amide) function in the body as components of two coenzymes: nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide (NAD) and nicotinamide ademne d nucleotide phosphate (NADP) Until recently, these vitamin B3 compounds were used exclusively to treat macin deficiency and pellegra

Today, however, vitamm B3 compounds have also found use m the area of skm care actives Bπtish Patent 1,370,236 describes compositions for skin lightening containing 0.5% to 10% niacin. Similarly, U.S. Patent 4,096,240 discloses the use of 0 1% to 10% niacinamide for skin lightening. Vitamm B3 compounds have also been found useful m regulating the texture of human skin. See PCT application WO 97/39733, to Oblong et al

However, when applied to the skm in crystallme form (i.e., powder), vitamm B3 compounds tend to impart a rough feel to the skm In the past, the crystalline vitamm B3 compounds were solubilized m a polar solvent before application to the skm, destroying the crystallme structure and thereby alleviating the rough feel of the crystals. However, solubilization reduced the efficacy of the vitamm B3 compound upon contact with the skm. Thus there exists a need for cosmetic compositions compπsmg unsolubilized crystallme vitamm B3 compound(s) which provide improved consumer perceived skm feel The present inventors have discovered that cosmetic formulations incorporating the crystalline vitamm B3 compounds of a specific crystallme structure and an emollient improve the consumer perceived feel of the vitamin B3 compound on the skm The present inventors have further discovered that these compositions are especially useful to impart vitamm B3 benefits to the lips with improved skm feel when used m lipstick compositions mcludmg a solidifying agent

It is, therefore, an aspect of the present invention to provide cosmetic compositions, preferably anhydrous cosmetic compositions, compπsmg select crystalline structured vitamm B3 compounds which improve the appearance and feel of the skm while alleviatmg the rough feel of the crystallme vitamm B3 compound.

Another aspect of the present invention is to provide anhydrous cosmetic compositions compnsmg selected crystallme structure vitamm B3 compounds which improve the feel of the vitamin B3 compound on the skm.

These and other aspects will become readily apparent from the detailed descπption which follows SUMMARY OF THE INVENTION
The present invention relates to cosmetic compositions providing improved skin feel, which contain from about 0.01% to about 50%, by weight, of cylindrical crystalline vitamin B3 compound particles having a particle size distribution such that at least about 70% of the crystalline particles have a height to width ratio greater than 1 ; from about 1% to about 90%, by weight, of an emollient; from about 1% to about 90%, by weight, of a solidifying agent; and from about 1% to about 90%, on an anhydrous basis, of a color. Preferably the compositions are anhydrous. The compositions of the present invention are useful for improving consumer perceived skin feel of cylindrical crystalline vitamin B3 compounds when applied to the skin.

All percentages, parts and ratios are based upon the total weight of the cosmetic compositions of the present invention, unless otherwise specified. All such weights as they pertain to listed ingredients are based on the active level and, therefore, do not include carriers or by-products that may be included in commercially available materials, unless otherwise specified.

As used herein, the term "cosmetics" includes make-up, foundation, and skin care products. The term "make-up" refers to products that leave color on the face, including foundation, blacks and browns, i.e., mascara, eye liners, brow colors, eye shadows, blushers, lip colors, and so forth. Skin care products are those used to treat or care for, or somehow moisturize, improve, or clean the skin. Products contemplated by the phrase "skin care products" include, but are not limited to, adhesives, bandages, toothpaste, anhydrous occlusive moisturizers, powder laundry detergent, fabric softener towels, occlusive drug delivery patches, antiperspirants, deodorants, nail polish, powders, tissues, wipes, solid emulsion compact, hair conditioners-anhydrous and the like. The term "foundation" refers to liquid, creme, mousse, pancake, concealer or like product created or reintroduced by cosmetic companies to even out the overall coloring of the skin. Foundation is manufactured to work better over moisturized and/or oiled skin.

As used herein the term "comprising" means that the composition can contain other ingredients which are compatible with the composition and which preferably do not substantially disrupt the compositions of the present invention. The term encompasses the terms "consisting of and "consisting essentially of.

The solubility of the vitamm B3 compound m the vanous non-polar emollients of the present invention can be determined as follows
I Preparation of Samples for Analysis
1 ) the emollient is placed m pre-weighted vial and the saturated with a vitamm B3 compound,

2) the vial is shaken and allowed to sit m a bath at 30°C for 1 hour A small stir bar is used to agitate the contents of the vial If no precipitation occurs m the vial, then more niacinamide is added This was repeated until precipitation occurred The sample is left m the bath for an additional 48 hours to insure saturation,
3) the saturated emollient is drawn mto a syringe,
4) A 045 micron filter (Gelman Acrodisc) is fitted on the end the syringe and the emollient is filtered through mto separate pre-weighted vial for analysis,
5) The emollient is analyzed usmg HPLC to determine the amount of niacinamide therein

Approximately 0 25g of the sample is weighed (sample weight) mto a 15mL plastic screw-cap centπfuge tube The sample is mixed with approximately 3mL of 50/50 v/v methanol/chloroform and
homogenized by vortex mixing About 7mL of water is then added to extract the vitamm B3 compound from the methanoL/chloroform phase Each sample is mixed by shaking 50 times m a back and forth motion to facilitate transfer of the niacinamide from the methanol/chloroform to the water phase This mixing creates an emulsion at the interface of the two phases The emulsion can be dissipated by letting the sample stand for several hours or by bπef centnfugation (15 seconds) at high speed Once the two phases have completely separated, a pipette is used to carefully transfer the aqueous phase mto a separate, pre-weighted vial The weight of the aqueous phase is noted (aqueous phase weight) An aliquot of the aqueous phase is transfeπed to an analysis container and analyzed for niacinamide by HPLC (Waters 2690 Separations Module coupled with a Waters 996 PDA detector, both supplied by Waters Corporations) III Calculations

The percent vitamm B3 compound is determined by taking the vitamm B3 compound concentration measured by HPLC and multiplying by the dilution factor The dilution factor is the aqueous phase weight divided by the sample weight
